# Hermes Agent FAQ & Troubleshooting Guide

---

## 1. Getting Started, UI & Observability
- **Web Dashboard:** Run `hermes dashboard` to start the local web interface at `http://127.0.0.1:9119`. The **Chat** tab embeds the full interactive terminal TUI.
- **Observability & Tracing:** Langfuse is bundled as an opt-in plugin. Enable it via `hermes plugins enable observability/langfuse` (or `hermes tools`) to view turn traces, tool inputs/outputs, and latency.
- **Open WebUI Streaming:** Tool progress SSE events stream automatically to Open WebUI without swallowed callbacks.
- **Security Vulnerability Reporting:** Report vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent/security/advisories/new) or email `security@nousresearch.com` per `SECURITY.md`.

---

## 2. Model Providers & Configuration
- **Local Ollama Overridden by Remote Keys:** When `provider: auto` detects remote environment variables (e.g., `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`), it may bypass your local endpoint. Force local execution in `~/.hermes/config.yaml`:
  ```yaml
  model:
    default: ollama/your-model
    provider: custom
    base_url: http://localhost:11434
  fallback_providers: []
  ```
- **Ollama Cloud 404 Errors:** Ollama Cloud uses OpenAI-compatible `/v1` endpoints (`https://ollama.com/v1`). Set `provider: ollama-cloud`.
- **Small Local Models (4B–9B) Running Slow:** The agent sends the full tool schema (~45 tools) on each turn, creating high prompt token overhead. To optimize:
  1. Disable unused toolsets with `hermes tools`.
  2. Use faster quantization or upgrade to a 32B+ model for tool-heavy tasks.
  3. Set `terminal.backend: local` to eliminate container overhead.
- **Vision Models on Custom/Local Endpoints:** Add `supports_vision: true` under your model configuration to enable native image payloads.
- **Azure AI Foundry:** Run `hermes setup` or set `provider: azure-foundry` (auto-detects `ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL`). Claude Code-specific env vars are ignored.
- **Claude Pro/Max vs. API Token Billing:** Anthropic API keys are billed on token usage. To use a Pro/Max subscription allowance, authenticate via OAuth instead of an API key.
- **Google Gemini:** Legacy CLI OAuth providers were removed due to upstream restrictions. Use Google AI Studio with `GOOGLE_API_KEY` or `GEMINI_API_KEY`.
- **DeepSeek V4 Pricing/Normalization:** Ensure Hermes is updated so `deepseek-v4-flash` passes through directly without normalizing to `deepseek-chat` / `deepseek-v4-pro`.
- **LocalAI / Usage Tracking:** Streaming requests send `stream_options: {include_usage: true}` automatically so `/usage` tracks accurate token counts.

---

## 3. Context, Memory & Task Execution
- **Core Identity & Memory Files:**
  - `SOUL.md`: Base agent persona, tone, and operational boundaries.
  - `USER.md`: Persistent user identity, background, and preferences (`target="user"`).
  - `MEMORY.md`: Long-term episodic memory and recalled facts.
- **Turn Limits & Long Tasks:** Conversations default to `agent.max_turns: 90` (override via `hermes chat --max-turns <N>`). For long autonomous tasks, use `/goal` to persist context across turns; resume paused tasks with `/goal resume`.
- **Context Compaction:** `ContextCompressor` prunes old verbose tool results while maintaining a recent context tail. Pluggable engines can be set via `context.engine`.
- **Skill Usage & Telemetry:** Skill loads and edits are recorded in `~/.hermes/skills/.usage.json`. View stats via `/insights` or `hermes insights`.
- **Local Honcho Server:** Pointing `base_url` to `localhost` or `127.0.0.1` automatically supplies a placeholder `"local"` key to avoid SDK auth errors.

---

## 4. Messaging Gateways & Media Delivery
- **Interactive Gateway Setup:** Run `hermes gateway setup` to configure Discord, Telegram, Slack, Matrix, and other platforms interactively without manual file editing.
- **Telegram "Unauthorized User":** `allowed_chats` only filters group chats. To authorize direct messages:
  - Add your numerical Telegram user ID to `telegram.allow_from` in `config.yaml`.
  - DM the bot, get the pairing code, and run `hermes pairing approve telegram <CODE>`.
  - Or set `telegram.allow_all: true` to permit all users.
- **Per-Channel Personas:** Define distinct prompt overlays per channel ID using `channel_prompts` in your platform config.
- **Multi-Profile Gateways:** Run multiple bot accounts (e.g., Weixin, Telegram) simultaneously via a single multiplexed gateway with isolated sessions and memory.
- **File & Media Routing:** Inbound `.txt` and `.py` files are injected directly into context. Outbound files route automatically to Matrix (`m.file`), Telegram, and Email attachments. DingTalk delivers image URLs as Markdown (`![image](url)`), and MCP image outputs (`MEDIA:<path>`) forward directly to supported channels.
- **Session Continuity:** Gateway restarts mark sessions as `resume_pending` to preserve chat history. Auto-resets are opt-in (`session_reset.mode: none`).

---

## 5. Extensibility & Development
- **Model Routing Policy:** Automatic complexity-based routing (`smart_model_routing`) is deliberately unsupported. Configure subagent models in `delegation.provider` / `delegation.model`, or switch manually with `/model` or `hermes chat -m <model>`.
- **Subagents:** Run parallel background tasks via the `delegate_task` tool (default concurrency: 3).
- **Custom Tools:** Create personal tools as plugins in `~/.hermes/plugins/` and enable them with `hermes plugins enable <name>`. Built-in tools go in `tools/` and must be registered in `toolsets.py`.
- **Memory Providers:** In-tree additions to `plugins/memory/` are closed. Third-party memory backends must be published as standalone plugins implementing the `MemoryProvider` ABC (`sync_turn`, `prefetch`, `shutdown`).

---

## 6. Installation & Platform Notes
- **Native Windows 10/11:** Tier 1 supported natively via PowerShell (`install.ps1`). WSL2 is only needed if using the POSIX PTY terminal tab in the web dashboard.
- **NAS & Docker Permissions:** Set `PUID` and `PGID` (or `HERMES_UID`/`HERMES_GID`) env vars to fix `[Errno 13] Permission denied` errors on bind mounts (`/opt/data`). Official Docker images support `linux/amd64` and `linux/arm64`.
- **Android (Termux):** Supported via `scripts/install.sh`, which selects the `.[termux-all]` package group and uses a writable `TMPDIR`.
- **Slow Updates:** Pauses during the Node.js update phase in `hermes update` occur while Camofox silently downloads browser binaries.
